text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

The panel's composition doesn't point anywhere useful here: you and the appointee are both women, so sex-based preference can't explain why she was chosen over you. An all-women panel in a ministry recruitment is also unremarkable and, on its own, evidence of nothing. Raising it would likely read as grasping, and would undercut the point you do have.

That point is procedural: two weeks with no written explanation. Send a short follow-up citing your original request and the ministry's own transparency or recruitment rules, with a deadline. Ask specifically how "experience of leading international projects" was weighted and scored against the published criteria. If the scoring was invented or applied inconsistently, that's your actual grievance.
